shorts.title: A Wolverine Climbed 1,500 Meters Up a Peak in 90 Minutes
shorts.outro: Doug tried to follow it up. That's in the full video below.
shorts.description: A collared wolverine called M3 went straight up Mount Cleveland in winter and down the far side, and the full wolverine episode is linked below.

shorts.title: One Young Wolverine Walked 800 km From Wyoming to Colorado
shorts.outro: Doug followed him with a paper map. Full video below.
shorts.description: In 2009 a collared male called M56 crossed Interstate 80 and kept walking south for two months; the full wolverine episode is linked below.

shorts.title: Wolverines Smell Carcasses Under Nearly Two Meters of Snow
shorts.outro: Doug tried hiding from one under the snow. Full video below.
shorts.description: A wolverine follows the smell of a buried winter carcass across the snow and digs straight down to it; the full wolverine episode is linked below.
